name: entscheidsuche
title: entscheidsuche-mcp
description: MCP server for Swiss court decisions and case law from entscheidsuche.ch. AI search by meaning (semantic search) and keyword search across Swiss Federal Supreme Court (BGer/BGE) and cantonal court decisions in German, French and Italian.

skills.name: Search Swiss case law (default)
skills.description: Default search: AI search by meaning for questions in natural language; switches to keyword search for case numbers, phrases and Boolean queries.

skills.name: AI search by meaning (semantic search)
skills.description: Embedding-based search for legal questions and descriptions of facts, across German, French and Italian decisions.

skills.name: Keyword search (exact terms)
skills.description: Full-text search for exact words, phrases and Boolean expressions with filters, sorting and pagination.

skills.name: Search by case number
skills.description: Exact lookup of Swiss case numbers, docket references and BGE citations.

skills.name: Fetch decision (full text)
skills.description: Retrieve a single decision together with its full text.

skills.name: List courts with decision counts
skills.description: Hierarchy IDs of cantons, courts and chambers with decision counts.

skills.name: Court tree with names
skills.description: Tree of cantons, courts and chambers with names in German, French and Italian.
